title: Digital Annex: Master Thesis on Transformation-Enabling Conditions

creators.name: Reinecke, Thomas
creators.affiliation: IU International University of Applied Sciences

description:
Digital annex of the master thesis Enterprise Transformation Readiness: A Design Science Study of Transformation-Enabling Conditions Operationalised in an AI-Supported Governance Application (M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence, IU International University of Applied Sciences, 2026).

The annex holds the records that are too large to print: the screening record of the systematic literature review, the Condition Findings with the source locators of their audited evidence and the contributing publications, and the classification record of all condition aspects.
